goal: POST requests to the REST getutxos endpoint incorrectly report that valid outpoints do not exist
REST clients querying UTXOs via POST get consistent results matching GET requests
Prevents excessive memory allocation from oversized inputs and rejects malformed requests
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified by reproducing the bug locally and confirming matching responses (Zeegaths)
Resolved objection: malformed or trailing POST bytes now properly return HTTP 400 (b-l-u-e)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because POST queries to the getutxos endpoint return incorrect results for valid outpoints
Restores functional parity with GET requests for REST API consumers
Mitigates potential resource exhaustion by capping vector allocation size on malformed inputs
